issue_context.title: ImageLocality plugin should consider initContainers when scoring during scheduling
issue_context.body:
### What would you like to be added?

We used to only calculate regular containers. However, initContainers should also be counted. 

### Why is this needed?

https://github.com/kubernetes/kubernetes/pull/110382#discussion_r897128424
Because initContainers are also pull request, we need to consider all initContainers when scoring the ImageLocality plugin. WDYT?
@kerthcet  @alculquicondor @Huang-Wei

review_comments: I am not sure this is worth it, our profiles constantly show various overheads of memory management overheads... Also, would the outcome really be different when the images are deduped?
oh.., we're summing the existence image size, do we have any concern here @xiaomudk otherwise I agree with remove this.

I thought about it carefully, and the repeated image should also be counted,  
because the ImageLocality plugin The value of is to make the pod start faster, and duplicate images can get higher scores. Start faster.   @denkensk WDYT?

In this way, I can remove the `sets.New[string]`

Let's think about it and if I am wrong please correct me. 

What affects pod startup time? In ImageLocality plugin, the size of image we need to download will affect, right? So we need to calculate the size of the image we need to download. 

Here we use the existing image size to calculate the size of the image we need to download. The higher the existing image size, the less we need to download right?

If we calculate the duplicate images here, it may not. Let me give you an extreme example, if the pods has 10 containers, 9 need image1(20m), 1 need image2(100m), and  we have two nodes: image1 in node1, image2 in node2, if we calculate the duplicate images here, we will pick node1 right?  But actually in node1, we need to download 100m, but in node2 we just need to download 20m.
@kerthcet @ahg-g As denkensk said, do you have any differing opinions?
My concern is more about adding logic to handle a corner case, but will add overhead to all other pods. Did you see the case you are referring to in practice?
@ahg-g I haven't come across it in practice, and the pod images are always different. So, your suggestion is that we don't need to consider duplicate images?
Then I think we should just leave it be for now, if it is not broken, don't fix it.
